title: Cholera toxin discovered
summary: Indian scientist Sambhu Nath De discovered cholera toxin in bacteria-free culture filtrate of Vibrio cholerae, and built an animal model of the disease.
why: Explained how cholera kills, the basis of later treatment and vaccine work.

unsung.contribution: Discovered the cholera toxin and an animal model for cholera.
unsung.recognition: His key paper was initially unrecognised; his work might have stayed unknown, even in India, without a 1986 tribute.
